sections.heading: What the record establishes
paragraphs: The Council of the European Union’s official summary identifies a weekly schedule of President António Costa covering 21–29 November 2026. This establishes the document’s subject and time window, but no individual appointment or policy theme is stated.

sections.heading: How to interpret it
paragraphs: A published schedule can make institutional activity more predictable and publicly visible. However, the absence of programme details means that claims about diplomacy, decisions, or consequences would exceed the available evidence. A schedule should therefore be paired with later official statements or meeting records before being used to establish outcomes.
